mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_grant_affected_pair ( user_id uuid NOT NULL, domain_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, domain_id) ) ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO lf_grant_affected_pair (user_id, domain_id) VALUES
(#{p.userId}, #{p.domainId})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO t_user_domain_grant_state (user_id, domain_id, granted, revision) SELECT user_id, domain_id, FALSE, 0 FROM lf_grant_affected_pair ORDER BY user_id, domain_id ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: DO $grant_lock$ BEGIN PERFORM grant_state.user_id FROM t_user_domain_grant_state grant_state JOIN lf_grant_affected_pair affected ON affected.user_id = grant_state.user_id AND affected.domain_id = grant_state.domain_id ORDER BY grant_state.user_id, grant_state.domain_id FOR UPDATE OF grant_state; END $grant_lock$
mapper.insert: WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT affected.user_id, affected.domain_id FROM lf_grant_affected_pair affected JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = affected.user_id JOIN t_role_domain role_domain ON role_domain.role_id = user_role.role_id AND role_domain.domain_id = affected.domain_id UNION SELECT affected.user_id, affected.domain_id FROM lf_grant_affected_pair affected JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = affected.user_id JOIN t_role_domain_group role_domain_group ON role_domain_group.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_domain_group_domain dgd ON dgd.domain_group_id = role_domain_group.domain_group_id AND dgd.domain_id = affected.domain_id UNION SELECT affected.user_id, affected.domain_id FROM lf_grant_affected_pair affected JOIN t_user_domain user_domain ON user_domain.user_id = affected.user_id AND user_domain.domain_id = affected.domain_id UNION SELECT affected.user_id, affected.domain_id FROM lf_grant_affected_pair affected JOIN t_user_domain_group user_domain_group ON user_domain_group.user_id = affected.user_id JOIN t_domain_group_domain dgd ON dgd.domain_group_id = user_domain_group.domain_group_id AND dgd.domain_id = affected.domain_id ), changed AS ( UPDATE t_user_domain_grant_state grant_state SET granted = (authorized.user_id IS NOT NULL), revision = grant_state.revision + 1, updated_at = CAST(#{occurredAt} AS timestamptz) FROM lf_grant_affected_pair affected LEFT JOIN authorized ON authorized.user_id = affected.user_id AND authorized.domain_id = affected.domain_id WHERE grant_state.user_id = affected.user_id AND grant_state.domain_id = affected.domain_id AND grant_state.granted IS DISTINCT FROM (authorized.user_id IS NOT NULL) RETURNING grant_state.user_id, grant_state.domain_id, grant_state.granted, grant_state.revision ), events AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT uuidv7() AS event_id, 'UserDomainGrantChanged'::varchar AS event_type, 'USER_DOMAIN:' || user_id::text || ':' || domain_id::text AS stream_key, domain_id::text AS partition_key, user_id, domain_id, granted, revision FROM changed ) INSERT INTO t_outbox_event (id, event_type, stream_key, partition_key, payload) SELECT event_id, event_type, stream_key, partition_key, jsonb_build_object( 'eventId', event_id::text, 'eventType', event_type, 'streamKey', stream_key, 'revision', revision, 'occurredAt', CAST(#{occurredAt} AS timestamptz), 'userId', user_id::text, 'domainId', domain_id::text, 'granted', granted ) FROM events
